info.title: SILO API v2 (deployed preview)
info.description: The v2 gateway over SILO's schema `api`: 14 resources, five shared parameters, one envelope and one error object. Generated from supabase/functions/silo-api/registry.ts by scripts/gen_openapi_v2.py; do not edit by hand. Deployed preview. The v2 gateway is live; v1 remains available.

get.description:
Deployed preview. What did the company file? Income, balance sheet, cash flow, headline figures and every stored version.

every line, one row per account, latest stored version. Paged by date windows. With no id (every kind): the research universe, whose cnpj links a ticker to its filer.

This playground selects `all` on `GET /statements`. See the [full resource reference](/api-docs/v2/reference/statements) for all variants.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: quarterly: ITR filings. annual: DFP filings. A quarterly filing holds the 3-month and the year-to-date figure; period_months on the row says which. Never add the two. Default: both.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Consolidated and individual are separate filings of the same period; they are never merged. Default: consolidated.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: By kind: all, income, balance, cashflow, headline, versions take a listed company's ticker, 14-digit CNPJ or CVM code. With no id, kinds all, income, balance, cashflow, headline, versions read api.research_universe (what SILO holds). Default: none.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the resource's default window, counted back from to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the latest complete period, from coverage.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The page size. More rows than one page come through next_page_url, never cut silently; a call stops at the tier's rows-per-call cap with meta.tier_cap_reached. Default: the tier's page maximum (10 anonymous, 100 signed in); a larger value is coerced to it.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The opaque cursor from a previous next_page_url. It carries every other parameter: send it alone (another parameter with a different value is bad_request). Default: none: the first page.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Hidden parameter (`?help=all` lists it). Point in time: only documents CVM received before this date, at the highest version known then. Not for kind versions. Default: none: the latest stored version of every document, which is NOT point in time.

parameters.name: account_code
parameters.description: Hidden parameter (`?help=all` lists it). For all or versions: exact filed account code. Check its filed label before comparing issuers. Omit for every line. Default: none: return all accounts.

default.description: The v2 error object. A SILO refusal (over_limit) keeps its message, hint and details verbatim.

bearerAuth.description: SILO user access token for authenticated data requests.

data.description: Always a list. Rows as the endpoint returned them; null stays null.

request.description: Every parameter the resource takes, with the default applied.

id_known.description: Whether SILO holds the id; null when the call names none.

tier_cap_reached.description: True when the result is partial because of the tier cap.

next_page_url.description: Present only when more rows remain. It carries one opaque cursor.
